forbidden_capabilities: GitHub Actions workflow, repository secret registration or unattended execution
active provider-profile registration or active preflight-requirements switch
model-bundle finalization, accepted model-bundle upload, benchmark, admission, activation or deployment
bucket creation, bucket deletion, versioning change, Object Lock configuration change or semantic bucket-policy mutation
credential values in command arguments, logs, evidence, Git, issues, pull requests, screenshots or chat
successful data-plane mutation without exact interactive confirmation
more than one 9437184-byte retained governed compatibility object or any retained multipart payload
acceptance: the authority contains all seven live REG.RU panel rules, including explicit control-key bucket and object denies
credentials are requested once per execution after all dependencies and local authority checks pass
expected denials are classified only from botocore ClientError Error.Code and ResponseMetadata.HTTPStatusCode rather than AWS CLI text formatting
TLS, connectivity, timeout, malformed response and HTTP 5xx failures remain fail-closed and cannot satisfy a denial proof
the exact live bucket policy is admin-read-only, validated locally, hashed and never retained
the finalizer is allowed on the governed prefix while the control key is denied listing, multipart creation and known-object reads
all successful mutations are bounded to one resumable 9437184-byte retained stream object and one fully aborted multipart upload
only a bounded sanitized report is retained and finalization_allowed remains false
